instructions: This file is one part of the interface of Forge Studio, an AI image and video app (Stable Diffusion WebUI Forge).
Translate every value in "texts" (and in "blocks", when there is one) into the language you were asked for. Never change a key: the program finds each text by its English key.
Fill in "language" with the language's own name (for example "Español"), "code" with its short code (for example "es" or "pt-br"), and set "direction" to "rtl" for a language written right to left.

Keep exactly as they are: {0}, {name} and other words in curly braces, %s, ${...}, HTML tags and their attributes, emoji, \n line breaks, numbers and units, keyboard keys, file names and paths, and code.

Keep the names of models, samplers, programs and formats in English (FLUX, SDXL, SD 1.5, LoRA, ControlNet, AnimateDiff, Deforum, Wan, VAE, CFG, Euler a, LCM, Hires. fix, PNG, MP4...). For a technical term the user will meet in English tutorials, add the English in brackets once, for example "Escala CFG (CFG Scale)".
Short labels stay short: they are buttons, tabs and field names. Use the plain, friendly words a video editor or a photo app uses in that language.
A value that should stay in English may stay unchanged.
Return the complete file as valid JSON with the same structure and nothing before or after it.

texts.Deforum draws a new figure over the moti: Deforum draws a new figure over the motion of a chain: every frame is drawn where the motion has its figure, on a flat backdrop, with a still camera and the same seed, held by ControlNet. Each frame appears in the 3D view as soon as it is drawn (🎮 Steer moves it through space while it grows); at the end the new chain is cut cleanly and stands where the motion stood.
texts.Or a new motion from a video: Or a new motion from a video
texts.A video of a moving figure: it is cut ou: A video of a moving figure: it is cut out into a motion chain first (as in the Chains tab), then drawn
texts.Give a video of a moving figure (one per: Give a video of a moving figure (one person, the whole body): it becomes the motion.
texts.Choose a video of a moving figure first: Choose a video of a moving figure first
texts.e.g. a dancer made of glowing glass, ful: e.g. a dancer made of glowing glass, full body
texts.Used when there are no scenes: Used when there are no scenes
texts.Like Infinite Zoom: each scene starts at: Like Infinite Zoom: each scene starts at a second of the motion with its own prompt and blends into the next. A scene may fill the figure with its own texture (a video or picture: water, fire, marble) and give it the look of its own picture. Without scenes, "Who is drawn" is used for every frame.
texts.who is drawn in this scene: who is drawn in this scene
texts.How long one scene takes to become the n: How long one scene takes to become the next
texts.A LoRA or words put before every scene (: A LoRA or words put before every scene (LCM needs its LoRA)
texts.Before Deforum draws, the figure can be: Before Deforum draws, the figure can be filled with a texture (a video of water, fire, clouds, or a picture) keeping its own light and shade: Deforum then draws a figure made of it. A scene's own texture replaces this one.
texts.0: the motion's own picture; 1: all text: 0: the motion's own picture; 1: all texture
texts.What holds each drawn frame to the motio: What holds each drawn frame to the motion. The pose is enough for a person; for a figure made of something else add the silhouette, and depth or edges for more of the body.
texts.Holds the body's pose, frame by frame: Holds the body's pose, frame by frame
texts.Keeps the body's volume and what is in f: Keeps the body's volume and what is in front of what
texts.Keeps the outlines: clothes, hair, finge: Keeps the outlines: clothes, hair, fingers
texts.The figure's exact shape, white on black: The figure's exact shape, white on black: the strongest hold for a figure made of something else (water, fire, smoke)
texts.Gives every frame the look of a picture: Gives every frame the look of a picture (a scene may have its own)
texts.The share of the steps it starts in (0:: The share of the steps it starts in (0: from the first)
texts.The share of the steps it stops after (1: The share of the steps it stops after (1: to the last)
texts.no model for it here: left out: no model for it here: left out
